facts.business: Laxmi Cotspin Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of cotton yarn, cotton bales, surgical cotton, oil cake and oilseeds.

auditor.name: DMKH & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on: 1) Inventory valuation - unable to ascertain correctness of quantity, condition and valuation of ~30,000 kgs of mutilated cotton bales valued at 37% lower than cost; 2) Advance to wholly owned subsidiary Laxmi Spintex Private Limited without prior Board approval and statutory compliance; 3) Advance to creditor - uncertainty regarding end-use and recoverability, no impairment/ECL assessment under Ind AS 109; 4) Sale of land to subsidiary Laxmi Spintex Private Limited not completed through registration of sale deed as at March 31, 2026; 5) Expected Credit Loss (ECL) not assessed/recognised on certain trade receivables outstanding over three years per Ind AS 109.

key_risks: Raw Material Price Risk - Cotton price fluctuations affecting production costs, inventory valuation and operating margins
Foreign Exchange Risk - Exposure to currency fluctuations from export sales, imports and foreign currency transactions
Market and Competition Risk - Highly competitive textile industry from domestic and international producers
Power and Energy Cost Risk - Energy intensive manufacturing, increases in electricity/fuel costs impacting production costs
Global Economic and Geopolitical Risk - Economic uncertainty, geopolitical conflicts, trade policy changes, supply-chain disruptions
Regulatory Risk - Changes in environmental, labour, corporate, taxation, textile and other regulations
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transaction: Company advanced financial assistance aggregating to ₹5.51 Crore to wholly owned subsidiary Laxmi Spintex Private Limited without obtaining prior shareholder approval as required under Regulation 23 of SEBI Listing Regulations. Also sale of land to Laxmi Spintex Private Limited recorded in previous financial year not completed through registration as at March 31, 2026.
